levels.title: Security badges
levels.mission: Check every badge in the balanced vault, one node at a time.

levels.title: Manual repair: single rotations
levels.mission: Four lopsided subtrees: click each pivot to apply the single rotation it needs.

levels.title: Manual repair: double rotations
levels.mission: Name LR or RL first for each crooked subtree, then click its pivot.

levels.title: Auto repair: predict the rotation
levels.mission: Name the rotation each insertion will cause before the vault rebalances itself.

levels.title: Boss: order statistics
levels.mission: Read kth(n-k+1), rotate to repair the vault and verify the node count twice.
